title: human synovium micro-regional proteomics analysis
projectDescription: To analyze synovium proteome heterogeneity in different position via LCM separation.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Synovium sections were dissected into voxels via laser microdissection, followed by in solution digestion without DTT / IAA using sequencing grade trypsin/lysC. Digested peptides were analyzed on a TimsTof flex machine using a 15 minute gradient in DIA mode
dataProcessingProtocol: Data search was performed using DIANN in library mode. Default parameters were used except excluding Cysteine Carbamidomethylation. In-house library was constructed using pooled synovium samples, fractionated using HPRP, following same treatment protocol and LC settings as samples. MS analysis was performed in DDA mode of the same MS machine.
